item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
I actually have a reason; the photo itself is also frozen in time. It's not "invulnerable", it's not manipulable by anything that takes time. It's a photo of the exact moment time is stopped for them.

Why is it here at all? vigorous handwave SCP dimensional parallal SCP babble bibble vigorous handwave

A truly time frozen photo would probably be a mirror, but hey, it fits the milieu.

item.content:encoded: I think this would be fine without the end note. At least drop the "photo is invulnerable" bit, it's kind of lolfoundation and unnecessary.

Sorry. Ish. Sorta. You know what I mean, I hope.

I've often thought that this site's discoverability sorta tanks hard once you get through the mainlists. There's a lot of free-floating tales that are hard to discover. Such as this one, once the reddit link fades out and it's no longer on the recent changes list.

Even if I already did a version of this for the site I still find this version entertaining. +1.

I'm now curious if there are more than two versions of the Night Before Christmas on the site. Time to go diggin'.

item.content:encoded:
I don't have any specific SCPs in mind, I just made them up. I suspect that some of them would get me in trouble if I, for instance, tried to actually write about an anomalous Horse that can only be talked about in Morse. (Of course.)

Same for the MTF teams, for what it's worth; most of the names I found on the site did not fit the established rhyming scheme and the ones that do don't necessarily fit into the story.
